name: Malpedia (API and pages)
operator: Fraunhofer FKIE (Fraunhofer Institute for Communication, Information Processing and Ergonomics)
tier_rationale: Academic institution with published terms (A8 trusted): 'trusted - MITRE ATT&CK and D3FEND (attack.mitre.org, d3fend.mitre.org), Malpedia (Fraunhofer FKIE)' (P300 cond 5); P296 provider tier trusted.

reliability.justification: Curated academic malware-family and actor reference with a bibliography: usually reliable; attribution claims follow the cited reports.

malpedia.description: Malpedia API token (team account; Authorization header only)
malpedia.plan_hint: optional team-account token; the API stays 'noncommercial' (CC BY-NC-SA 3.0) until a written Fraunhofer FKIE agreement is recorded in licence_allow (P296 cond 1); token-tier material carries TLP:AMBER and is never exported (P296 cond 3)

api.title: Malpedia API (find/get/list actors and families, bibliography)

terms.quote: Licence (A1 initial class, legal floor): Malpedia content is CC BY-NC-SA 3.0, class 'noncommercial': off under the corporate profile until licence-cleared.

api.notes: A1 initial class (binding): 'Team Cymru MHR, Robtex, Malpedia, blocklist.de, CINS, ET, GreenSnow, DataPlane and Phishing Army = 'noncommercial''. Research C0658 terms 'Content CC BY-NC-SA 3.0 (non-commercial!); non-public material TLP:AMBER.' Endpoint allow-list in code: list/families, find/actor, get/actor and get/family only; no sample, YARA or other download endpoint can be built (P296 cond 2). Caching: list/families 7 days (P296 cond 5). Used by malpedia.
api.licensed_alternative: A written Fraunhofer FKIE agreement ('alternative agreements' per its ToS) recorded in licence_allow (P296 cond 1); under the corporate profile the bundled MISP galaxy Malpedia cluster (P295) and the manual pages (malpedia.pages, P300) cover family/actor ids and references.

pages.title: Malpedia family and actor pages /details/{slug}, /actor/{id} (manual pivot links)

terms.quote: Manual browsing is unaffected by the API's CC BY-NC-SA licence and is the corporate-profile fallback for P296.

pages.notes: Research C0674 terms 'site terms'. Manual links malpedia.caad.fkie.fraunhofer.de/details/{slug} and /actor/{actor_id}, the slug taken from the P295 alias-index mapping, never from the raw family name (P300 cond 9). Used by pivots_cti.

notes: Seeded once for batches p2-G14-2 and p3-G11-1 (P296, P300). ttl 604800 is the cap needed for the 7-day list/families cache (P296 cond 5); undocumented limits: min_interval 2 s, no quota block.
